accept_html_file_generation.text: Accept the generated HTML file to complete the creation process. Cognotik has prepared a professional, self-contained presentation file that you can save, share, and present immediately without any additional formatting or editing required.

ai_model_selection.text: Assemble your AI dream team strategically. Choose powerful models like GPT-4 for complex reasoning tasks and efficient models like GPT-3.5 for quick analysis work. Mix and match intelligently to optimize both capability and cost-effectiveness for your specific workflow requirements.

ai_provider_ecosystem.text: Choose from an extensive ecosystem of AI providers - from OpenAI's GPT models to Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini, and emerging providers like Cohere and Mistral. Mix and match models strategically to find the perfect combination of capability, cost, and performance for your specific needs.

ai_workspace_configuration.text: Configure your AI workspace with precision and intention. Select the optimal models for your specific task complexity and set up your ideal working environment - creating the perfect foundation for highly productive, goal-oriented AI collaboration.

auto_fix_automation.text: Unleash AI with intelligent full automation. Cognotik automatically analyzes problems, generates multiple solution approaches, implements fixes, and retries with learned improvements - transforming major roadblocks into minor speed bumps in your workflow.

auto_fix_debugging_capabilities.text: Deploy intelligent AI-powered debugging and problem resolution. Auto-fix tasks automatically detect errors, analyze root causes with sophisticated reasoning, and implement robust solutions - like having an expert debugger and problem-solver working alongside you 24/7.

autonomous_control_parameters.text: Fine-tune autonomous behavior to match your comfort level and project requirements. Set intelligent limits, safety parameters, and approval thresholds - maintaining precise control while maximizing AI capability and efficiency.

autonomous_mode_capabilities.text: Autonomous mode unleashes AI's full potential for independent operation. Simply set a goal, and watch as Cognotik independently plans, executes, and dynamically adapts - handling complex multi-step projects with minimal supervision while you focus on higher-level strategy and creative direction.

basic_chat_option.text: Need something simpler and more immediate? Basic Chat offers instant AI conversations without any setup complexity - perfect for quick questions, spontaneous brainstorming sessions, or when you simply want to chat with advanced AI models without configuration overhead.

basic_chat_welcome.text: Let's start with Cognotik's Basic Chat - a streamlined yet powerful interface that gives you immediate access to advanced AI models, enhanced with unique features like parallel expansion syntax and integrated visual diagram support.

byok_approach_explanation.text: With Cognotik's 'Bring Your Own Key' approach, you maintain complete ownership and control. Connect directly to leading AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google - no middleman, no markup, no vendor lock-in. Just transparent access to cutting-edge AI at true cost with full privacy protection.

chat_mode_capabilities.text: Chat mode delivers the familiar conversational experience, supercharged with Cognotik's advanced task execution capabilities. Perfect for brainstorming sessions, rapid problem-solving, and exploring complex ideas through natural, flowing dialogue that leads to actionable results.

chat_mode_superpowers.text: Enter Chat Mode with superpowers - where natural conversation seamlessly meets advanced task execution capabilities. This isn't just chatting; it's intelligent collaborative problem-solving with AI that can actually research, analyze, create, and deliver tangible results.

code_execution_capabilities.text: Transform AI into a powerful code execution engine. Run code directly through Cognotik with real-time feedback and error handling - perfect for rapid prototyping, automated testing, and iterative development cycles.

cognitive_architecture_intro.text: At the heart of Cognotik lies our revolutionary cognitive architecture - AI that truly adapts to how you think and work. Unlike traditional chatbots that force you into their rigid patterns, Cognotik offers specialized cognitive modes that seamlessly match your natural workflow, from quick conversations to complex multi-step projects.

cognitive_modes_overview.text: Choose your AI's cognitive approach strategically. Cognotik's cognitive modes aren't just different interfaces - they represent fundamentally different methodologies for thinking and problem-solving, each carefully optimized for specific workflows, complexity levels, and desired outcomes.

demo_conclusion.text: You've just witnessed the future of intelligent AI assistance and project management. From simple conversations to complex project execution, Cognotik seamlessly adapts to how you think, work, and create - transforming AI from a mere tool into a true collaborative partner. Ready to revolutionize your workflow and unlock your full potential?

demo_plan_ahead_execution_graph.text: Visualize your project's execution flow with automatically generated, professional diagrams. This interactive Mermaid chart shows the complete task dependency graph - illustrating exactly how each step connects, depends on, and builds upon the others for optimal project flow.

demo_plan_ahead_per_task_details.text: Dive deep into individual task specifications and requirements. Each task displays detailed requirements, expected outputs, technical dependencies, and success criteria - giving you complete transparency and understanding before any execution begins.

demo_plan_ahead_tabs_container.text: Plan Ahead mode intelligently organizes complex project information into clear, easily navigable sections. Each tab provides a different crucial perspective on your project - from high-level strategic overview to detailed execution steps and technical specifications.

enter_research_query.text: Time for a compelling real-world demonstration. We're asking Cognotik to research current sustainable energy trends - watch as it conducts comprehensive web research, analyzes multiple sources, and synthesizes complex findings into clear, actionable insights.

expansion_syntax_intro.text: Cognotik's revolutionary expansion syntax enables parallel thinking and unparalleled query flexibility. Responses can be processed either in parallel or sequentially, allowing you to explore multiple perspectives, approaches, and insights within a single, powerful interaction.

file_modification_capabilities.text: Give AI hands-on file control and creative freedom. From creating new documents to editing existing code and refactoring complex systems, file modification tasks let Cognotik directly interact with your project files - like having an expert AI pair programmer working collaboratively alongside you.

file_search_capabilities.text: Navigate complex projects with AI-powered intelligence. File search tasks help Cognotik understand your codebase structure, locate relevant files across directories, and analyze project organization patterns - absolutely essential for working efficiently with large, complex codebases.

generate_directory_demo.text: One click creates a perfectly organized, professional workspace structure. Cognotik automatically generates intelligently timestamped directories that keep each session's work cleanly separated and easily identifiable - eliminating the frustration of hunting through cluttered folders and lost files.

github_search_capabilities.text: Tap into the world's largest code repository and collective developer intelligence. GitHub search tasks enable Cognotik to explore open-source projects, discover proven implementation patterns, and learn from millions of developers' battle-tested solutions.

goal_oriented_mode_capabilities.text: Goal Oriented mode transforms vague objectives into structured pathways to success. Define your target outcome, and Cognotik creates measurable milestones, tracks progress intelligently, and dynamically adapts strategies to ensure you reach your destination efficiently.

html_slides_generated.text: From initial question to polished presentation in just minutes. Cognotik has transformed a simple research request into a professional, self-contained HTML presentation - showcasing the complete research-to-output pipeline that would typically require hours of manual work across multiple tools.

insight_analysis_capabilities.text: Insight tasks transform raw information into deep understanding and actionable intelligence. Perfect for analyzing complex datasets, extracting key insights from lengthy documents, and making sense of intricate situations with sophisticated AI-powered analysis and synthesis.

intro_welcome.text: Welcome to Cognotik - the AI platform that thinks like you do. Whether you're a developer, researcher, or creative professional, Cognotik transforms complex AI interactions into intuitive, powerful workflows that adapt to your unique thinking style. Let's discover how Cognotik can revolutionize your work.

introduction_conclusion.text: You've just discovered Cognotik's powerful foundation - a revolutionary platform that adapts advanced AI to your unique thinking style and workflow patterns. Now let's see this groundbreaking approach in action with compelling real-world demonstrations.

launch_research_session.text: Your research powerhouse is now online and ready for action. With web crawling and file modification capabilities enabled, Cognotik can now conduct comprehensive research, analyze findings intelligently, and generate professional reports - all within one seamless, integrated workflow.

local_tools_integration.text: Transform your local environment into an AI-powered workspace. Cognotik securely integrates with your development tools, command line utilities, and file systems - giving AI the rich context and capabilities it needs to become a true collaborative partner in your work.

mermaid_diagram_example.text: Watch as raw text transforms into visual intelligence before your eyes. AI automatically generates properly formatted, professional diagrams that render instantly and beautifully - perfect for documentation, presentations, or simply understanding complex workflows and relationships.

mermaid_support_intro.text: Transform complex, abstract ideas into clear, professional visuals. Cognotik's built-in Mermaid support empowers AI to create sophisticated diagrams, flowcharts, and data visualizations - turning difficult concepts into immediately understandable, shareable graphics.

parallel_expansion_example.text: Witness how one thoughtfully crafted question sparks multiple intelligent, complementary responses. Each perspective adds unique value - theoretical foundations, practical applications, and real-world examples - giving you complete, multi-dimensional understanding in a single interaction.

plan_ahead_mode_capabilities.text: Plan Ahead mode brings complete transparency to complex projects. AI creates comprehensive, reviewable project plans before any execution begins - perfect for software development, research initiatives, and any collaborative work requiring careful coordination and stakeholder approval.

plan_ahead_mode_intro.text: Welcome to Plan Ahead Mode - where AI becomes your expert project architect and strategic planner. Instead of diving straight into execution, Cognotik first creates comprehensive, detailed, and reviewable project plans that give you complete visibility and control over complex, multi-step projects.

request_html_report.text: Transform research into professional presentation format. Now we're asking Cognotik to create a polished HTML slide presentation from the research findings - demonstrating how AI can take raw information and transform it into polished, immediately shareable outputs.

review_configuration.text: Your AI assistant is fully configured and optimized for action. Take a moment to review your carefully chosen settings one final time - you're about to experience AI that truly understands, adapts to, and dramatically enhances your unique workflow and objectives.

sequential_expansion_example.text: Notice how context and understanding flow seamlessly between interactions. Each response builds intelligently and contextually on what came before, creating a natural, logical progression from general concepts to specific, immediately actionable insights.

sequential_expansion_intro.text: Now witness the power of sequential expansion - where intelligently crafted follow-up questions unlock progressively deeper insights. Cognotik builds contextually upon previous responses, creating rich, layered understanding that evolves naturally with your curiosity and needs.

shell_command_capabilities.text: Unleash the full power of command-line automation through AI. Shell command tasks let Cognotik run terminal commands, execute complex scripts, and interact with system tools - seamlessly bridging the gap between AI intelligence and raw system capabilities.

specify_feature_details.text: Paint the complete project picture with detailed requirements. We're providing comprehensive specifications for a React TypeScript application - user authentication, interactive dashboard with charts, responsive design, and modern UI components. Watch as Cognotik transforms these high-level requirements into a detailed, actionable development plan.

specify_tech_tools.text: Define your project's technical foundation with precision. In Plan Ahead Mode, we specify the exact technology stack, development tools, and environment requirements - ensuring AI fully understands your constraints, preferences, and technical context before comprehensive planning begins.

step1_cognitive_modes.text: Step 1: Select your cognitive approach. Cognotik's cognitive modes aren't just different interfaces - they represent fundamentally different ways of thinking and problem-solving, each carefully optimized for specific workflows, complexity levels, and desired outcomes.

step2_task_settings.text: Step 2: Optimize your AI engine for peak performance. These critical settings determine how Cognotik thinks, operates, and delivers results - from selecting the optimal AI models for your specific task complexity to configuring the workspace where the magic happens.

step3_task_types.text: Step 3: Unlock AI superpowers through task specialization. Each task type grants Cognotik specific, powerful capabilities - from writing and executing code to searching the web and analyzing complex files. Strategically choose your AI's toolkit for maximum impact.

step4_launch.text: Step 4: Launch into the future of AI collaboration. Your personalized AI workspace is fully configured and optimized. Time to experience the transformative power of truly intelligent, capable AI assistance tailored precisely to your unique needs and workflow.

task_types_research_intro.text: Unlock powerful research superpowers for comprehensive information gathering. We're enabling file modification for professional report generation and web crawling for thorough research - giving AI the essential tools to gather, analyze, and synthesize information like an expert research assistant.

temperature_control.text: Fine-tune AI creativity and consistency with precision temperature control. Low values (0.1-0.3) deliver precise, deterministic results perfect for code generation and technical analysis. Higher values (0.7-1.0) unlock creative potential for brainstorming and innovative problem-solving.

themes_customization.text: Experience instant personalization at your fingertips. Switch themes and layouts dynamically to create the perfect visual environment for any task - from focused, distraction-free coding sessions to vibrant, inspiring creative brainstorming environments.

themes_layout_intro.text: Make Cognotik truly yours with extensive visual customization options. Choose from multiple carefully designed themes and layouts that match your personal style and optimize your specific workflow - because great AI deserves an equally great, personalized interface.

usage_transparency.text: Maintain complete control with transparent, detailed usage reporting. Track API costs in real-time, monitor model performance metrics, and optimize your AI spending strategically - gaining complete visibility into your AI investment with actionable insights for continuous improvement.

web_search_capabilities.text: Connect AI to the world's vast, ever-expanding knowledge base. Web search tasks let Cognotik research current information, gather technical documentation, and incorporate real-time data into solutions - ensuring AI responses remain current, comprehensive, and grounded in the latest developments.

working_directory_concept.text: Define your project's operational home base. The working directory becomes Cognotik's dedicated workspace - where it creates files, executes code, and organizes all outputs systematically. Think of it as giving AI its own dedicated project folder with complete creative and operational freedom.

workspace_configuration.text: Set up your personalized AI workspace thoughtfully. Choose where Cognotik will operate and which AI models will power your session - creating a carefully optimized environment that balances your specific needs, performance requirements, and budget constraints.

workspace_setup.text: First, let's set up your personalized workspace. Cognotik's comprehensive user settings give you complete control over your AI experience - from connecting your preferred AI providers to seamlessly integrating your local development tools and environment.
